name: Reply Drafter
nl_definition: When someone asks when I'm free, draft a reply offering my availability. Always ask me first.
do_span: draft a reply offering my availability

trigger.semantic: The sender is asking when Jatin is available, or proposing times to meet.

spec.instruction: Read the thread. Draft a reply that names the times Jatin has already said work, in his register: short, no filler, no exclamation marks. Never send it.
